entries.t: Snipe

[Snipe] deals damage equal to your power to 1 Medabot!
It takes no counterattack, even from a standby foe.
Guard

When a Medabot with [Guard] is in play, the foe's
normal attacks and Cross Attacks can only hit it!
Transfer a [Guard] Medabot to protect your leader.
Burn

A Medabot with [Burn]
loses 3000 power when it attacks!
Bind

A Medabot with [Bind]
must discard 2 extra cards for quick cooldown!
Shock

A Medabot with [Shock] cannot be re-transferred!
It also cannot activate abilities (actions)!
Freeze

A Medabot with [Freeze] cannot be re-transferred!
Worse, it cannot take any action at all!
Frenzy

[Frenzy] adds 2000 power when a Medabot attacks!
Overlooking it on a low-power Medabot will hurt!
Deathlock

With [Deathlock] you cannot discard from your hand!
Quick cooldown, which costs discards, is blocked too!
No Attack

[No Attack] blocks normal attacks and Cross Attacks,
but the Medabot can still counterattack!
Barrier Limit

A card with a [Barrier Limit] can only be played
while your leader's barrier is that value or lower!
Strong, but you cannot play it early on!
Repair

[Repair] makes 1 card in your hand a barrier!
Not usable at max barrier or with an empty hand!
Medabot Destruction

[Medabot Destruction] covers support Medabots and also
the destruction of a leader's parts or barriers!
Quick Cooldown

[Quick Cooldown] puts a Medabot on standby at once.
Its cost is discarding the stated number of cards!
Set

[Set] is an action paid with the listed Set Points.
It places traps and plants on the field!
Draw Pile and Deck

[Draw Pile] is the set of cards you use in a game.
In this game your first draw pile is 35 cards.
During a Robattle it is called your [Deck]!
Hand

Your [Hand] is the cards drawn from your deck to play.
In the Draw phase, draw until your hand has 6.
You must hold 5 or fewer when the End phase ends.
Field
The [Field] is where cards sit in a Robattle, split into areas.
Discards

[Discards] are cards used at once or removed from play.
The [Discard Pile] is where those cards are kept.
Deck Out

[Deck Out] is when you keep drawing cards
until your deck runs out. The moment you
cannot draw from your deck, you lose!
Turn

A [Turn] is everything that happens from when
your side starts until the foe's side begins.
In this game a [Turn] runs through 4 [Phases] in order!
Terrain Bonus

[Terrain Bonus] is earned when the terrain area
matches your leader's leg type. At Robattle start,
2 Tactics cards for that leg type join your barrier hand!
Medaforce

[Medaforce] cards can only be used once your barrier drops.
As your Medal levels up, you can run up to 2 in a deck!
Favorite Cards

Your [Favorite Card] shows what your deck is about.
Pick one from the cards in your deck!
Sleeve

A [Sleeve] changes the back of your cards.
Earn more by meeting certain conditions!
Player Icon

Your [Player Icon] is the mark that stands for you.
Earn more by meeting certain conditions!
Wallpaper

A [Wallpaper] changes the menu background.
Earn more by meeting certain conditions!
Action Attacks

Attacks from actions, such as long-range shots,
ignore the foe's [Guard]!
Effect

An [Effect] comes from non-attack abilities, or from
Tactics, Medafighter and Medaforce cards you play.
Traps and Plants

Two things can be set on the field: [Traps] and [Plants].
A [Trap] vanishes once it triggers and resolves,
but a [Plant] stays and keeps working until destroyed!
Cross Attack

[Cross Attack] lets several Medabots attack together.
Hit the leader to break 1 part and barrier per attacker!
